segments.title: Cold Open: Papito Sign-On
segments.notes: Papito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on from the control room, coughing through the countdown and acknowledging chatters including Skymer (garbled as S.K.O.A.M.Y.R.).

segments.title: Elon Musk $56B Tesla Pay Package
segments.notes: Case and Crum discuss shareholder approval of Musk's compensation package; Crum argues the pay reflects market value while Case questions the sum; Crum's coughing fit persists throughout.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Tuna Rarebit, Onion Sandwiches & Electrolyte Drink
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget broadcasts from his woodshop with his father's spirit trapped in a board; technical glitches trap Jeb between dimensions; Hype Train possesses Jeb during a sub alert; recipes reviewed for tuna rarebit, Jack Popper's onion sandwiches, and a homemade electrolyte drink.

segments.title: Kitchen Cooking Segment: Tuna Rarebit & Green Onion Latte
segments.notes: Case and Kendall cook in Case's kitchen: tuna rarebit sandwiches (curdled), onion sandwiches, and a Chinese TikTok trend green onion latte; Kendall assists with prep but declines to eat due to lactose intolerance; Case strains tuna post-stream.

segments.title: Jeb Outro & Green Onion Latte Follow-Up
segments.notes: Back in the woodshop, Jeb and his dad debrief; Kendall describes her first week working for Jeb; Jeb makes a second green onion latte live; raid received (destination omitted).

segments.title: ISS Mutant Superbugs & Miscellaneous News
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple cover 13 strains of drug-resistant Enterobacter bugandensis on the ISS; tangent on cicadas, moon landing conspiracy, street sharks, and water world theory; Ripple's audio issues persist.

segments.title: The Jo Rogen Experience: Void Sync & Elk Herpes
segments.notes: Case and Ripple as dual Joe Rogans troubleshoot audio delay via void impression; discuss elk meat tasting like herpes, moon landing fakery, spin kicks vs parries in Elden Ring, Jamie fusing with the studio wall.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Nudity vs. Clothes Debate
segments.notes: Munch at 100 debate wins, Crum at 99; Munch argues nudity unleashes powerful masculine aura; Crum cites practical protection; Munch threatens to summon phantom versions of himself; scoreboard stretched wider.

segments.title: Elden Ring Gaming & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case transitions to Elden Ring DLC playthrough; mentions changing sheets after kitchen segment; stream crashes on countdown.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors news desk, hosts Jo Rogen Experience, cooks tuna rarebit with Kendall, transitions to Elden Ring at close.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers sign-on as 'Papito'; coughs through countdown; later jammed on buttons during outro causing dual-Papito glitch.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates Musk pay package at news desk; appears in Munch & Crum at 99 debate wins vs Munch's 100; argues for practical clothing.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Assists Case in kitchen cooking segment; reveals lactose intolerance; describes first week working for Jeb; declines green onion latte.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosts How To with Jeb from woodshop; suffers dimensional glitches; temporarily possessed by Hype Train; makes green onion latte.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host (spirit in board). Trapped in wooden board; bickers with Jeb; comments on Jeb's brother Jet; reacts to Hype Train possession.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype correspondent. Possesses Jeb's body during sub alert; delivers freestyle rap thanking subscribers; declares rage and hype from donations.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosts Jo Rogen Experience as second Joe Rogan; discusses ISS superbugs, elk herpes, moon landing, street sharks.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Leads debate score 100-99; argues nudity is humanity's powerful form; threatens to summon phantom selves; stretches scoreboard graphic.

storylines.beat: [2:51:59] Munch reaches 100 debate wins, Crum at 99; Munch stretches scoreboard graphic; Crum vows to catch up before 8-hour debate marathon.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito referred to as 'Papito' throughout broadcast; acknowledges chatters including Skymer (ASR: S.K.O.A.M.Y.R.).
Kendelle confirms lactose intolerance: 'my body can't do milk or yogurt' but eats cheese selectively.
Hype Train possesses Jeb Nogget's body during sub alert, delivering freestyle rap as 'Hype Train Jeb'.
Green onion latte identified as Chinese TikTok trend: spring onions at bottom of cup with ice, coffee, milk, garnished with scallions.
Munch's debate win streak reaches 100; Crum at 99; scoreboard graphic stretched wider to accommodate triple digits.
Jamie (Jo Rogen producer) described as fusing with studio wall, face disappearing into drywall; stomach gurgles heard through floor.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opens with a glitchy Papito sign-on before Case and Crum dissect Elon Musk's $56B Tesla pay package. The broadcast pivots to a chaotic How To with Jeb featuring dimensional instability, a Hype Train possession, and recipe reviews. Case and Kendall then cook tuna rarebit, onion sandwiches, and a viral green onion latte in the studio kitchen. A second news block covers ISS mutant superbugs and moon landing conspiracy theories. The Jo Rogen Experience troubleshoots audio via void impressions while discussing elk herpes and Elden Ring mechanics. Munch & Crum debate nudity versus clothing with the scoreboard at 100-99. The episode ends as Case launches into Elden Ring DLC before the stream crashes.
